briefing.description: Film director Damian Vance was killed on set when a pyrotechnic charge exploded prematurely during a wide shot. Log files from the control booth show the signal originated from an auxiliary wireless transmitter.
briefing.warning: Involves descriptions of explosive blast hazards.

victim.name: Damian Vance
victim.modeOfDeath: Blunt force trauma from premature pyrotechnic explosion.

witnesses.statement: The explosion went off two minutes early. Damian was right next to the charge, tweaking a camera position.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Did you notice anything unusual with the detonator setup?
A: The main control console was locked, but Jaxson was hanging around the stage left equipment rack at 18:00.
Q: Did Damian say anything before the shot?
A: He mentioned he was going to officially blacklist Jaxson as soon as filming wrapped.

suspects.name: Jaxson Drake
suspects.alibi: Claims he was recalibrating basic cable connections near stage left.
suspects.relationToVictim: Damian publicly blamed Jaxson for a previous safety fine and threatened to ruin his career.

messages.text: Did you set the secondary receiver to 433MHz like I asked? I'm leaving it by stage left so we don't get channel crosstalk.

suspects.name: Evelyn Reed
suspects.alibi: In her dressing trailer doing makeup touch-ups with her stylist.
suspects.relationToVictim: In a bitter contract dispute over revenue shares.

suspects.name: Trent Mercer
suspects.alibi: In the monitoring booth observing the camera feeds with the crew.
suspects.relationToVictim: Stood to collect an insurance payout if production halted.

messages.text: If this shot gets delayed again, our completion bond guarantors are going to pull funding.

evidence.name: Auxiliary RF Transmitter
evidence.description: A handheld RF transmitter found tucked behind stage left equipment, tuned to 433MHz with a pre-programmed timer for 18:18.

evidence.name: Fingerprint Traces
evidence.description: Partial fingerprint on the transmitter battery pack matching Jaxson Drake.

solution.closingStatement: Jaxson Drake hid an auxiliary wireless transmitter set to the 433MHz band behind stage left equipment, timing it to detonate at 18:18 while Damian was near the charge to retaliate against Damian's threat to ruin his career.

briefing.description: A set of rare antique diamonds vanished from an estate library safe during a thunderstorm blackout. The mechanical combination had been dialed correctly, and no physical damage was done to the vault door.
briefing.warning: Focus on access to the cipher code written inside a specific book.

witnesses.statement: Only family members knew the safe combination was derived from the cipher inside the rare book on the library desk.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who went near the library around the time of the storm?
A: Julian went in there right before dinner at 20:00. He looked anxious when the weather started turning.
Q: Where were the other family members?
A: Clara was on the south patio on a phone call, and Gideon was down in the basement archive.

suspects.name: Julian Sterling
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the dining room pouring drinks during the entire blackout.
suspects.relationToVictim: Heavily in debt to private creditors.

messages.text: My lender gave me until midnight. I need to get that book off the library desk before the estate lawyer arrives tomorrow.

suspects.name: Clara Sterling
suspects.alibi: In the conservatory on a phone call with her legal team.
suspects.relationToVictim: Upset about estate management decisions.

suspects.name: Gideon Ross
suspects.alibi: Working down in the basement archive rooms.
suspects.relationToVictim: Fearing termination after an upcoming estate audit.

messages.text: The archive audit starts tomorrow morning. All basement records are organized.

evidence.name: Bookmark in Rare Book
evidence.description: A silk bookmark placed at page 114 of the cipher book in the library, marking the exact combination formula.

evidence.name: Security Vault Log
evidence.description: Mechanical tumbler logs confirm the safe combination was dialed at 21:20 during the power blackout.

solution.closingStatement: Julian Sterling used the 15-minute power blackout to slip into the library, read the cipher from page 114, and open the vault to steal the diamonds to pay off his mounting debts.

briefing.description: Head Sommelier Julian Dupont collapsed after sampling a vintage red wine during a private tasting event. The bottle was unsealed at the table, but analysis revealed aconite was present in his glass.
briefing.warning: Consider how the toxin was introduced without contaminating the shared decanter.

victim.name: Julian Dupont
victim.modeOfDeath: Aconite toxicity leading to cardiac arrhythmia.
routine: 21:10 - Pours initial tasting glasses for VIP guests

witnesses.statement: We all drank from the same decanter. Julian only drank from his own silver tasting cup from his jacket pocket.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who handled the tasting setup before the event?
A: Antoine prepared the silver cups and coat racks in the pantry around 20:00.
Q: Did Julian leave his tasting cup unattended?
A: He keeps it in his coat, but Antoine carried Julian's coat into the pantry right before service.

suspects.name: Antoine Blanc
suspects.alibi: Claims he was polishing glassware in the pantry.
suspects.relationToVictim: Passed over twice for promotion in favor of Julian.

messages.text: I'm prepping Julian's coat and silver cup in the back now. He'll be using it for the 21:00 tasting.

suspects.name: Beatrice Laurent
suspects.alibi: Seated at the VIP tasting table.
suspects.relationToVictim: Concerned about a critical review Julian was writing.

suspects.name: Luc Moreau
suspects.alibi: Checking reservations at the front host stand.
suspects.relationToVictim: Disputed accounting logs with Julian.

messages.text: Make sure table 4 receives the 1982 decanter on time.

evidence.name: Silver Tasting Cup
evidence.description: Julian's personal silver cup contained heavy residue of aconite poison.

evidence.name: Botanical Vials
evidence.description: Found in Antoine's locker: concentrated monkshood extract vials.

solution.closingStatement: Antoine Blanc coated the inside of Julian's personal silver tasting cup with aconite in the pantry prior to the service, ensuring only Julian would ingest the fatal toxin.

briefing.description: A deep-space radio telescope array was shut down when its primary cryo-cooling line ruptured. system logs show a manual valve override command was issued from a guest terminal.
briefing.warning: Look closely at coolant line valve overrides and terminal access logs.

victim.name: Apex Telescope Observatory
routine: 22:00 - Observatory dome rotates to target position
01:00 - Pressure anomaly detected in Coolant Line 3

witnesses.statement: The pressure relief valve was manually locked shut in the control software, overriding safety shutoffs.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who logged into that control terminal tonight?
A: Terminal 3 executed an admin override around midnight. Dr. Thorne was granted temporary access to that workstation earlier.
Q: Could this have been an automated glitch?
A: No, someone had to manually click through two software warnings.

suspects.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
suspects.alibi: Claims he was analyzing data streams in his dorm room.
suspects.relationToVictim: His paper was about to be rendered obsolete by tonight's sky survey data.

messages.text: Thanks for the Terminal 3 guest login. I'm going to run a manual diagnostic on the cooling telemetry now.

suspects.name: Elena Rostova
suspects.alibi: Monitoring remote feeds from home.
suspects.relationToVictim: Frustrated by recent department budget reallocations.

suspects.name: Siddharth Patel
suspects.alibi: On duty in the auxiliary generator station.
suspects.relationToVictim: Facing administrative review over safety logging delays.

messages.text: Generator levels are nominal. Heading over to inspect the auxiliary power bay.

evidence.name: Override Terminal Log
evidence.description: Terminal session logs show pressure valve 3 was locked closed at 00:30 using Dr. Aris Thorne's guest credentials.

evidence.name: Ruptured Alloy Pipe
evidence.description: Physical piping shows structural failure due to rapid thermal expansion behind the locked valve.

solution.closingStatement: Dr. Aris Thorne used his temporary access on Terminal 3 to lock the pressure relief valve closed at 00:30, causing the sensor array to overheat and destroy the survey data that threatened his research.

briefing.description: Opera singer Helena Rostova survived a dangerous fall when a stage counterweight rigging snapped mid-performance. Examination suggests a steel support cable was deliberately weakened with acid.
briefing.warning: Check access to stage rigging lofts during intermissions.

witnesses.statement: The harness cable was intact before intermission. Someone went up to the loft during the break.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Did you see anyone near the fly loft during intermission?
A: Nadia came up the catwalk stairs around 20:50 claiming she was looking for a misplaced prop.
Q: Was anyone else up there?
A: No, the lighting crew was down on the main stage floor.

suspects.name: Nadia Vance
suspects.alibi: Claims she was in dressing room 3 during the entire intermission.
suspects.relationToVictim: Stood to take over the starring role if Helena was unable to perform.

messages.text: Is the loft staircase unlocked during intermission? I think I left my prop gloves near line 4.

suspects.name: Marcus Kane
suspects.alibi: In the lighting booth directing crew adjustments.
suspects.relationToVictim: Argued with Helena over artistic direction.

suspects.name: Victor Chen
suspects.alibi: Setting up floor props backstage.
suspects.relationToVictim: Disputed damaged prop charges with management.

messages.text: All stage floor props are lined up and ready for Act II.

evidence.name: Corroded Cable Strand
evidence.description: Steel fly cable shows rapid chemical corrosion consistent with concentrated nitric acid application.

evidence.name: Acid Dropper Bottle
evidence.description: An empty glass dropper bottle with nitric acid residue found in Nadia's costume rack.

solution.closingStatement: Nadia Vance accessed the fly loft catwalk during intermission and applied nitric acid to the harness cable, intending to injure Helena so she could step into the lead role.

briefing.description: A shipping firm's primary server vault was intentionally flooded, destroying physical and electronic financial ledgers right before a federal audit. An automatic sump valve was remotely reprogrammed to pump seawater into the facility.
briefing.warning: Examine remote valve commands and security system log-ins.

witnesses.statement: I saw a vehicle parked near the intake pump control house around 21:45.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Could you see who was inside the car?
A: I couldn't make out the face, but the driver was using a corporate tablet connected to our encrypted remote network.
Q: Who has access to that network?
A: Only upper executive management like Mr. Vance.

suspects.name: Robert Vance
suspects.alibi: Claims he was attending a dinner gala in the city center.
suspects.relationToVictim: Facing severe prison time if federal auditors discovered millions in missing funds.

messages.text: Confirming my remote login is working on the harbor portal. Need to review pump logs before tomorrow's audit.

suspects.name: Samantha Wright
suspects.alibi: At her hotel reviewing preliminary spreadsheets.
suspects.relationToVictim: Attempting to pressure company management during contract negotiations.

suspects.name: Gavin Ross
suspects.alibi: At home playing video games.
suspects.relationToVictim: Unhappy about recent compensation changes.

messages.text: Weekly data backups finished without errors. Turning in for the night.

evidence.name: Remote Transmission Log
evidence.description: Cellular modem log shows valve activation command sent from Robert Vance's personal mobile IP at 21:30.

evidence.name: Corroded Drive Array
evidence.description: Server storage drives heavily damaged by high-salinity seawater.

solution.closingStatement: Robert Vance logged into the remote portal at 21:30 to trigger the harbor intake valve, intentionally flooding the server vault to destroy evidence of his embezzlement before federal auditors arrived.

briefing.description: Skydiving instructor Gavin Cross died when both his primary and reserve parachutes failed during a demonstration jump. Analysis revealed the reserve ripcord cable had been severed inside its housing sheath.
briefing.warning: Examine who had access to the parachute rig in the hangar.

victim.name: Gavin Cross
victim.modeOfDeath: Impact trauma due to parachute failure.

witnesses.statement: I saw someone spending a lot of time around Gavin's gear locker around noon.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who was working near the locker?
A: Derek was bent over Gavin's rig with a tool kit around 12:10. He claimed he was fixing a snagged flap.
Q: Did Gavin inspect the rig afterward?
A: Gavin grabbed it right before takeoff, assuming Derek had finished standard packing.

suspects.name: Derek Miller
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the flight lounge watching TV.
suspects.relationToVictim: Gavin recently discovered Derek was stealing high-end gear and selling it online.

messages.text: I'll handle Gavin's reserve packing today. Need to grab my wire cutters from the main workbench.

suspects.name: Chloe Bennett
suspects.alibi: Piloting the jump plane during the demonstration.
suspects.relationToVictim: Disputed facility ownership rights.

suspects.name: Lucas Vance
suspects.alibi: Conducting a tandem jump with clients on another runway.
suspects.relationToVictim: Lost a corporate sponsorship contract to Gavin.

messages.text: Ready for the 14:30 jump when you guys are.

evidence.name: Cut Reserve Cable
evidence.description: Internal stainless steel ripcord cable cleanly sliced inside its plastic housing tube.

evidence.name: Wire Cutters with Fibers
evidence.description: Found in Derek's tool cabinet: heavy-duty wire cutters carrying nylon thread fibers matching Gavin's pack.

solution.closingStatement: Derek Miller cut Gavin's reserve ripcord cable inside the housing sheath at 12:10 to prevent Gavin from turning him in for stealing and reselling hangar equipment.

briefing.description: An autonomous robotic forklift collided with a structural support column inside a distribution center, causing a major shelf collapse. Software logs show modified pathfinding code was executed right before the crash.
briefing.warning: Analyze script deployment timestamps and maintenance logs.

witnesses.statement: Unit 12 sped straight into Column 4. Its collision proximity sensors never activated.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who modified the navigation software tonight?
A: Owen pushed a patch update at 02:35, right before his remote credentials expired at midnight shift end.
Q: Did anyone touch the vehicle hardware?
A: Kyle checked the battery at 02:30, but hardware diagnostics show no defects.

suspects.name: Owen Zhang
suspects.alibi: Working remotely from home.
suspects.relationToVictim: Upset about being included in upcoming corporate layoffs.

messages.text: Pushing my final navigation code patch now before my account access locks tonight.

suspects.name: Maya Lin
suspects.alibi: In her office filing inventory reports.
suspects.relationToVictim: Blamed by upper management for recent shipping delays.

suspects.name: Kyle Vance
suspects.alibi: Servicing battery charging stations.
suspects.relationToVictim: Denied safety bonus pay after recent equipment evaluations.

messages.text: Unit 12 battery replaced and fully charged.

evidence.name: Malicious Navigation Script
evidence.description: Script uploaded to unit navigation server disabled proximity sensors and forced high-speed target lock on Column 4.

evidence.name: IP Connection Record
evidence.description: Upload connection originating from Owen Zhang's home IP address at 02:35.

solution.closingStatement: Owen Zhang deployed a malicious pathfinding script from his home IP address at 02:35, overriding Unit 12's proximity sensors and steering it into Column 4 in retaliation for his upcoming layoff.

briefing.description: Artist Dominic Thorne was found dead in his private studio. Cause of death was acute cyanide gas inhalation, linked to a modified aerosol spray canister found beside his easel.
briefing.warning: Investigate studio supply drops and aerosol canister modifications.

witnesses.statement: Dominic always locked his door from the inside while painting. The studio exhaust fan was running normally.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who brought the spray paint supplies into the studio?
A: Julian Vance dropped off a restock crate of fixative sprays around 18:30 and insisted on placing them in the cabinet himself.
Q: Did Dominic use those sprays right away?
A: Yes, he always finishes his evening canvases with that red fixative spray.

suspects.name: Julian Vance
suspects.alibi: Attending a gallery opening downtown.
suspects.relationToVictim: Dominic was planning to break his contract and expose Julian's fraudulent accounting.

messages.text: I'm dropping off the pressurized fixative cans at 18:30. Put canister #3 right in the front row for him.

suspects.name: Seraphina Ross
suspects.alibi: In her personal studio preparing for an exhibit.
suspects.relationToVictim: Accused Dominic of plagiarizing her signature technique.

suspects.name: Elliot Thorne
suspects.alibi: At home reviewing tax documents.
suspects.relationToVictim: Stood to inherit Dominic's art collection.

messages.text: Dominic said he wants to review our financial records tomorrow.

evidence.name: Tampered Aerosol Canister
evidence.description: Fixative canister #3 found modified with a high-pressure cyanide gas charge.

evidence.name: Storage Lock Footprints
evidence.description: Footprints near the studio supply cabinet matching Julian Vance's shoes.

solution.closingStatement: Julian Vance swapped canister #3 in Dominic's supply cabinet with a rigged aerosol spray containing cyanide gas, killing Dominic when he sprayed his canvas to prevent his accounting fraud from being exposed.

briefing.description: The CEO of an organic beverage company was hospitalized after drinking a sample from a production run. The main batch tank was pure, but his personal quality-testing flask was laced with organophosphates.
briefing.warning: Consider testing flask handling along the quality inspection line.

victim.name: Harrison Sterling
routine: 09:15 - Samples drink from personal testing flask

witnesses.statement: The 5,000-gallon drink batch was completely pure. The toxin was only inside Harrison's personal flask.
witnesses.qna:
Q: Who had access to Harrison's personal flask before the inspection?
A: Dr. Aris Vance took the flask into Lab 2 around 08:20 to 'prep it' after taking pesticides from the chemical cabinet.
Q: Did Harrison notice anything unusual?
A: No, he grabbed his flask directly off Aris's desk at 09:00 right before sampling.

suspects.name: Dr. Aris Vance
suspects.alibi: In the main testing laboratory.
suspects.relationToVictim: Harrison was about to fire Aris for failing environmental compliance audits.

messages.text: I have Harrison's silver flask in Lab 2. I'll make sure it's prepped before he starts the 09:00 inspection.

suspects.name: Clara Higgins
suspects.alibi: Conducting a plant tour with visiting investors.
suspects.relationToVictim: Competing with Harrison for corporate control.

suspects.name: David Park
suspects.alibi: In his office verifying shipping manifests.
suspects.relationToVictim: Blamed by Harrison for recent ingredient sourcing losses.

messages.text: Batch 404 is mixed and ready for quality control.

evidence.name: Coated Silver Flask
evidence.description: Internal coating of organophosphate pesticide found inside Harrison's personal tasting flask.

evidence.name: Chemical Storage Log
evidence.description: Log indicates organophosphate pesticide was removed from Dr. Aris Vance's lab drawer at 08:15.

solution.closingStatement: Dr. Aris Vance coated Harrison's personal tasting flask with organophosphates in Lab 2 prior to the 09:00 inspection, attempting to poison Harrison before he could be fired for failing environmental compliance audits.
